rules.statement: A partition decree is conclusive against all persons, even those with a concealed interest in the land, and bars any subsequent claim to that interest.
rules.supporting_quote: The effect of such a decree is to determine all pre-existing right or title and every claim to any right or title to the subject of partition. The decree in the partition case relied on by the defendant is binding and conclusive against the plaintiff as effectively as if he himself had been a party to the case.
